cues.en: And what it means at a higher level is that at any instance the program state is completely described by the code you see. And this is guaranteed to be true at any point during your process with your notebook.
cues.zh: 从更高层面说，这意味着在任何时刻，程序状态完全由你看到的代码描述。而且在你使用笔记本的过程中，这一点在任何时刻都保证成立。

cues.en: In particular, it means that the program state is not described by the code you had on your screen an hour ago.
cues.zh: 尤其意味着，程序状态不由你一小时前屏幕上的代码描述。

cues.en: Variables that you defined before, don't live on forever.
cues.zh: 你之前定义的变量不会永远存在。

cues.en: we think it's not just cool for nice demos,

cues.zh: 而且它实际上能帮你从一开始就避免很多 bug 发生。

cues.en: So most people will never have to think about how this works, but today we'll take a look behind the scenes. So whenever you change a cell, Pluto does two things. So first it figures out which cells also need to run and it does so using a dependency graph between your cells of the notebook.
cues.zh: 所以大多数人永远不用考虑它怎么工作，但今天我们会看看幕后。每当你修改一个单元格，Pluto 会做两件事。首先，它用笔记本单元格之间的依赖图，找出哪些单元格也需要运行。

cues.en: And the second thing is that it cleans up scope effects from your old code. So if you define a variable X and then you delete that code or change that code, then the variable X will also get deleted.
cues.zh: 第二件事是，它会清理旧代码中的作用域影响。所以如果你定义变量 X，然后删除或修改那段代码，变量 X 也会被删除。
